domain.title: Neural-Driven ISP Pipelines and AdaptiveISP
domain.summary: This research outlines the shift from traditional fixed-algorithm ISP pipelines to Neural ISPs, utilizing deep reinforcement learning to dynamically adjust RAW-to-RGB transformations. It introduces the AdaptiveISP framework to tailor image quality for downstream computer vision tasks.
domain.takeaway: As someone working on Snapdragon flagship camera solutions, the transition to task-driven Neural ISPs and hardware-software co-design is highly relevant for optimizing power and latency in next-gen mobile SoCs.

tech.title: DRIFT: Deep Restoration, ISP Fusion, and Tone-mapping
tech.summary: This recent arXiv submission (cs.CV) highlights the merging of multi-frame restoration with ISP and tone-mapping into unified, deep-learning-based architectures, significantly outperforming classical denoising.
tech.takeaway: Multi-frame HDR and deep learning-based image enhancement are directly aligned with your tuning work, showing how these pipelines are becoming entirely unified.

random.title: Novel Capture Modalities: Lensless Imaging and Event-Based Sensors
random.summary: Explorations in lensless imaging and event-based sensors that break conventional optical physics limits, allowing for high-resolution, wide-field imaging without bulky lens systems.
random.takeaway: It challenges the fundamental 'telephoto physics wall' by suggesting computational compensation for physical limitations.
